title: White House allows blocked reporters in after judge lifts Trump ban
summary: A recent ruling by District Judge Tim Kelly has mandated the immediate restoration of access for CNN, MSNBC, and Politico, which had been barred from the White House following a ban announced by President Trump on September 18. The decision underscores the ongoing tensions between the media and the administration, highlighting the importance of press freedom in a democratic society. This development is seen as a significant victory for journalistic integrity and the rights of the press to report on government activities without undue interference.
